## 席位注记 · stopped at step 4/5 · 2026-11-03T06:05Z

Blocked-by: #29814

The card thread measured step 1 on `origin/main` `b62463f1`. The published object document has an untranslated, author-owned read: `GET /meta/object/X/layers`, `overlay ?? code`. A pending draft has none. Studio's and Setup's object editors build the buffer as `draft ?? layers.effective ?? layers.code`, and the draft read (`?state=draft`) is always translated and governed, with no opt-out. Per step 4/5 the card stops here, and the seat filed the server card #29814 (`domain:server`).

The seat chose not to ship a partial client edit (no-draft path only, `Part of`). After the first autosave every open goes through the draft, so a partial PR would leave the common path red.

`pm:dispatched` comes off and `pm:blocked` goes on. No branch was pushed. When #29814 lands, the card returns to `pm:queue`, and the seat that takes it starts from the card thread's step-1 notes. Those notes name the read and PUT sites: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx:8004-8039` / `:8321`, `ResourceEditPage.tsx:1348-1400`, and plugin-designer `MetadataObjectsPage.tsx:178/287` and `MetadataFieldsPage.tsx:913/961`.

domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGDmSYVyFomEEAdU3

Measured on `main` at `589049b0` (the #29790 merge), 18.3.0 wave-5 run QA run #29893, zh-CN Studio save check: the server half holds (an `en` read after a zh Studio save and publish serves the source labels; an author `queue` is refused 422 at save and at publish). Two user-visible effects of this card's designer half, for whoever takes it:

- An author who changes a label in zh-CN Studio (`标题` → `主题`) stores the Chinese as the source: `en` readers get `主题`, while zh readers, the author included after a reload, keep getting the catalog's `标题`, so the edit looks reverted to its author.
- Once a draft exists, every zh autosave raises the toast "已保存 — 编辑检查提出了 9 条建议", listing English `translated-label-echo` advisories (label, pluralLabel, description, each field's label and help, the options), on a save that changed no label.

Repro: runtime package, object with a published zh-CN bundle; zh-CN browser; Studio `/_console/studio/PKG/data`, make one draft edit, reload, Form tab, field inspector, edit the help text and blur → toast; set `[data-testid=field-label-input]` to `主题` → the draft row stores `fields.title.label: '主题'`.
